previous_jets.setting: Any orthogonal reflection commuting with heat and the full Leray nonlinearity; initial velocity is reflection-odd.
previous_jets.energy_coefficient: C/3, C=<N(u0),DN(u0)DN(u0)N(u0)>; <N,D2N[N,N]>=0 by incompressible kinetic cancellation
previous_jets.scope: Free-algebra identities checked; reflection equivariance, PDE smoothness and Hilbert Taylor passage are analytic.

previous_pressure.domain: T3=(R/(2pi Z))^3, circular data supported transversely in r<5/2<pi
previous_pressure.canonical_pressure: p0(r)+eps*(2chi+r chi_prime)*cos(kz)/k, p0_prime=r*f0; subtract its mean
previous_pressure.generated_parent: N(u0)=eps*(-k r chi cos(kz),0,(2chi+r chi_prime)sin(kz)) in cylindrical components
previous_pressure.exact_return: C=-2pi^2 eps^2 k^2 integral r^3 chi^2*(4f0+r f0_prime) dr
previous_pressure.growing_example: f0=r^-6 on supp chi: C=4pi^2 eps^2 k^2 integral r^-3 chi^2 dr>0
previous_pressure.depleting_example: f0=1 on supp chi: C=-8pi^2 eps^2 k^2 integral r^3 chi^2 dr<0
previous_pressure.generality: Any smooth nonzero compact circular swirl has an annulus with decreasing squared angular momentum, permitting the growing construction.

full_observer.operator: Any self-adjoint metric commuting with reflection, specialized to -Delta.
full_observer.physical_stretching: g(U)=0 and g_prime(0)=G for every nu>0
full_observer.scope: The algebra checks the complete time jets; the PDE Taylor remainder and integrations by parts remain analytic.

annular.base: b_base=r^(-p) on the compact annular modulation support; unchanged CF pressure reconstruction
annular.lower_bound: G2>=pi^2*p*k^4*integral r^3*chi^2 dr>0 for p>=1, k>=1, chi nonzero
annular.sign_separation: 1<=p<2: C<0 but G>0 for every sufficiently small nonzero eps; p=2: C=0 but G>0; p>2: C>0 and G>0
annular.remainder: G is even and smooth in eps on a fixed source-positive compact parameter interval; no time or viscosity limit is used in this coefficient.

parameter_window.remainder_bound: M=(1/24)*sup_{|eps|<=eps_dom}|d_eps^4 G(eps)|<infinity, computed from the original compact profiles only.
parameter_window.bump_bound: For the CF compact exponential bump, G2>=125*pi^2*p*k^4*exp(-32/3)/128.
parameter_window.distinction: This static initial-parameter choice does not define a budget by taking a supremum over an unknown future solution.

interval.datum: Fix any smooth reflection-odd U with G>0; scale it to amplitude*U at fixed viscosity nu>0.
interval.constants: D0=||Delta U||2^2>0, K=2*D0/G; on a common local interval, |g(v_eta(tau))-G*tau|<=Cg*tau^2 and |D(v_eta(tau))-D0|<=CD*tau.
interval.local_scope: v_eta is the actual unforced solution at viscosity eta in (0,1]; uniform local Sobolev estimates fix tau0,Cg,CD from U.
interval.same_endpoint: For C_parent<0, uniform parent and full-enstrophy Taylor errors Pe*tau^5 and Ee*tau^3 permit eta_star also <=(-C_parent)/(6*K*(1+Pe)) and <=G/(2*K*(1+Ee)). Then parent energy is below its original forecast and full enstrophy is above heat at t_amplitude.
interval.limit: Refutes zero allowance on an actual short prefix; no counterexample to a finite allowance depending on the full scaled datum.

status: Analytic actual periodic NS comparison with exact algebraic fixtures; no new Lean certificate and no arbitrary-history payment.
